notes.title: Patrick's Parabox out now on Switch and PS5
notes.content:
Patrick's Parabox has recently released on Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5!

I'm happy for the game to be available on consoles now, so more people can enjoy it! If you know someone who might be interested in the console release, let them know! And thanks again to everyone who's played the game on Steam and made the PC launch so successful. :)

notes.title: 25% discount during Cerebral Puzzle Showcase
notes.content:
Patrick's Parabox is 25% off during the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase, from August 3-7!

Cerebral Puzzle Showcase is an event on Steam celebrating puzzle games. Lots of discounts on great puzzle games, new puzzle game releases, interviews and streams of puzzle games.

I'm happy for Patrick's Parabox to be on discount as part of this event! :) It was a really cool event last year, and this year's looks bigger and better!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase]Check out Cerebral Puzzle Showcase here[/url]

notes.title: Steam Awards 2022
notes.content:
Hi all!

Thanks so much for playing and enjoying Patrick's Parabox. I've said this before, but I'm thrilled at the reception the game has gotten! :)

Nominations for the Steam Awards are now open, for games released in 2022. If you would like, please consider nominating the game for an award! I think the game suits the Most Innovative Gameplay Award. Feel free to choose any category you might like.

Thank you! :)

notes.title: Cerebral Puzzle Showcase sale, and Linelith released
notes.content:
Patrick's Parabox is part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase, which just started, and is running from May 19-23! Get the game on discount.

But regardless of if you've picked up Patrick's Parabox or not, I highly recommend checking out the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase! It's a high-quality curation of puzzle games, discounts, hidden gems, demos, new releases, and streams, appealing to both puzzle fanatics and newcomers looking for good puzzle games!

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase

Also, I've just released a short puzzle game called Linelith, as part of the CosmOS 9 bundle, a special bundle of 9 short and sweet puzzle games discovered in space! Linelith is a much, much shorter game than Patrick's Parabox, but I think it turned out well! Definitely recommend checking it and the bundle out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1923790/Linelith/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25434/CosmOS_9/

notes.title: Minor bugfix update 2022-04-13
notes.content:
Hi all, I've just uploaded a minor bugfix update.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Tweak puzzle Open 5
[*] Change puzzle Challenge 35 due to the solution relying on a bug which has since been fixed. (whoops!)
[*] Add settings to disable player eye movement, and to disable mouse click zooming.
[/list]
Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] For custom levels, make Unity editor project export level files consistently using periods instead of commas (if your operating system is set to a locale which uses commas in decimal numbers, please use this new version)
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patrick's Parabox is an absolutely brilliant mind-bending puzzle game out now
notes.content:
Patrick's Parabox is a puzzle game about boxes within boxes, it's an absolute gem and I've had a fantastic time playing through this one.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/04/patricks-parabox-is-an-absolutely-brilliant-mind-bending-puzzle-game-out-now

notes.title: Patrick's Parabox is your new indie puzzle darling
notes.content: So many indie puzzlers start with a pretty simple premise, like "what if you could put boxes inside of other boxes," and end with absolute mind-bending madness like "I have seven layers of boxes and they seem to have started infinitely recurring.".. Read more.

notes.title: Patrick's Parabox Out Now
notes.content:
Patrick's Parabox is out now for Windows, Mac, and Linux!

I'm excited to see everyone's reactions and reviews! To everyone who's been following the game for any amount of time, thank you for your interest and your patience, and I hope you enjoy the finished game! :)

notes.title: Patrick's Parabox releasing on March 29th, 2022
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that Patrick's Parabox will be releasing on March 29th, 2022! (2022-03-29)

It’s been a long journey making this game. Thank you for your interest, your kind words, your support, and your patience over the years. I’m happy with how Parabox has turned out, and I’m excited for y'all to experience it! :)

And thanks to everyone who has played or given feedback on the demo!

notes.title: Patrick's Parabox Dev + Composer Chat with Patrick, Priscilla, and Peter
notes.content:
Join us for a casual chat about the design and sound of the upcoming award-winning recursive puzzler Patrick's Parabox! We'll chat about things like game design, development, and sound design for the game (which you will be able to hear for yourself in the new demo!). And joining Patrick and Prsicilla will be our friend Peter, to ask us questions and chat with us. I think it'll be a fun time! :)

Featuring:
Patrick Traynor - developer
Priscilla Snow - composer + sound designer
Peter Doria - friend

notes.title: Recursive puzzler Patrick's Parabox flaunts boxes within boxes within boxes
notes.content:
Patrick’s Parabox is too smart for me. Granted, regular Sokoban is often too smart for me, but thanks to a very simple concept, Patrick Traynor’s recursive boxes are creating mazes within mazes – tiles that transcend dimensions as my headache turns into a full-blown migraine. While he’s not ready to unleash his Paraboxes onto the public, you can catch his puzzles in a new trailer posted this week.

(more…)
